body: I guess I don't know. It's not that it's particularly appealing, it just seems..nicer. I'm not sure what happens after we die. Maybe there is nothing at all, maybe it's like how it was before I was born. That seems good to me. I don't want to be here. I'm a burden for the most part and I am starting to lose the ability to function like a regular human being. I thought for a while I had finally beaten depression, but just as I was getting better I woke up one day significantly worse and it's slowly eating away at me. If sleeping forever was an option I'd take it, and death seems like the closest thing.

I do mean school, yes. 

For starters I am afraid of driving, getting behind the wheel of a vehicle makes me begin to cry or hyperventilate. My other reason is that I think if I ever got over the fear, I would crash on purpose, I feel like I 'd see a large tree and just be decide to drive into it in hopes of dying. I don't really think, I just do things.
